title: Earning Reward Points on a Northbeam Circle Membership
content:
## The reward point balance

The reward point balance on a Northbeam Circle Membership is the running sum of the points put on and
taken off it. Points are earned on an earning occasion; a protection plan bought at the same time as a
purchase earns the plan bonus percentage of the plan price in points, and this is booked as its own
earning occasion rather than folded into the purchase.

## Where no points are earned at all

No points are earned while the membership stands in grace on a tier that suspends benefits, and none at
all once it has lapsed or been cancelled.

## Clauses of this policy no longer in force

The following clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**:

1. The clause earning points on qualifying merchandise spend taken as the merchandise total of the
   purchase net of tax, delivery, installation and every discount applied at the till.
2. The clause applying the base rate of the tier recorded on the day of the purchase to all qualifying
   spend, adding the computing, mobile and home-theatre bonus or the major appliance bonus on top of the
   base rate for the part of the spend in that department, and never adding the two department bonuses to
   each other on the same line.
3. The clause stopping further earning once the membership had earned the yearly points cap of its tier
   within one calendar year, read against the points earned over the rolling twelve calendar months
   ending on the handling date, month boundaries inclusive, only for the part of that window falling
   inside the calendar year.
4. The clause rounding earned points to the nearest whole point with a half point rounded up. The
   rounding recorded as a figure of this policy, to the nearest whole point with a half point rounded up,
   stays a figure of the policy.
5. The clause removing the points on a purchase later returned as a goodwill adjustment against the
   original purchase reference.

## What the tier still supplies

Each tier of Northbeam Circle Membership continues to carry its own base rate per USD, its computing,
mobile and home-theatre figure, its major appliance figure, its yearly points ceiling and its protection
plan percentage; those figures remain the figures of the tier. On Circle Business Elite, whose protection
plan percentage is 8, a hypothetical plan price of 250.00 carries 20 points on the plan's own earning
occasion.

superseded_clauses: The base rate of the tier recorded on the membership on the day of the purchase applies to all qualifying spend, and the computing, mobile and home-theatre bonus or the major appliance bonus is added on top of the base rate for the part of the spend in that department; the two department bonuses are never added to each other on the same line.
Points are earned on qualifying merchandise spend, which is the merchandise total of the purchase net of tax, delivery, installation and every discount applied at the till.

Once the membership has earned the yearly points cap of its tier within one calendar year, further purchases in that year earn nothing, and the cap is read against membership_msr_points_earned_12m only for the part of the window falling inside the calendar year.
Earned points are rounded to the nearest whole point, with a half point rounded up.
Points on a purchase that is later returned are removed as a goodwill adjustment against the original purchase reference.
